items.label: Dongshan Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
items.signal_prefix: R&D (annual report): R&D spend RMB 1,431,775,054.82 in 2025

set.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D spend RMB 1,431,775,054.82 in 2025, up 13.02%, 3.57% of revenue; 5,074 R&D staff. Optical R&D projects and their status: 1.6T OSFP DR8 3nm EML-based module (self-developed EML), and 800G QDD DR8&2xFR4 Gen2 (20% lower power than Gen1) in small-batch trial production; 1.6T OSFP 2xFR4 and 2LR4 EML modules, 1.6T DR8&2xFR4 silicon-photonics modules 'with BRCM and Xphor PIC' and 'with Marvell and Xphor PIC' (the latter to use the short delivery cycle of Marvell's 3nm DSP to answer urgent orders from global cloud and AI companies, and to seize what the company calls the 2026 first year of 1.6T volume ramp), and 800G DR4++ in sample making / verification; 800G AEC (active electrical cable) samples delivered to customers and 1.6T AEC in sample making; 3.2T OSFP-XD DR8, 6.4T/3.2T NPO for scale-up, 6.4T/12.8T XPO and a 1.6T LRO module (30% lower power than a 1.6T design with DSPs on both ends) in scheme evaluation; a 6.4T ELSFP external-laser module for CPO/NPO switches using its own CW laser in development. Chips: 212Gbaud EML for single-wave 400G (3.2T/6.4T modules) in design optimisation and sample making; 106Gbaud differential EML and CWDM/LWDM EML chips in sample making. AI PCB research includes 0-4mil back-drill stub length required by a leading AI customer (the company says the industry capability is 2-6mil) and 11-step HDI.

items.reason: The report names the project '1.6T OSFP DR8 3nm ... EML scheme' and says it uses self-developed EML; it does not say the 3nm part is a DSP (only the separate Marvell silicon-photonics project names a 3nm DSP). Wording narrowed to what the table states.
